from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyComprehensiveIncome(BaseModel):
    """Comprehensive income result from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as reported in the document")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock security code, if provided in the document")
    comprehensive_income_total: float | None = Field(description="The '综合收益总额' value; negative if loss")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the amount (e.g., 元, 百万元)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g., 2024年第一季度")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the comprehensive income value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_comprehensive_income_results: list[CompanyComprehensiveIncome]
